lyrics.ja: 固まった意識に革新のピースを
lyrics.romaji: Katamatta Ishiki ni Kakushin no Piisu wo
lyrics.en: Into this rigid consciousness, place a piece of innovation
lyrics.zh: 將革新的碎片嵌入僵化的意識中

lyrics.ja: 何気ない時間　砕け散った
lyrics.romaji: Nanigenai Jikan Kudake Chitta
lyrics.en: Ordinary moments shattered to pieces
lyrics.zh: 平凡的時間碎散四處

lyrics.ja: 不器用なフレーズで誤魔化してそっちの
lyrics.romaji: Bukiyou na Fureezu de Gomakashite Socchi no
lyrics.en: Covering it up with clumsy phrases
lyrics.zh: 用笨拙的詞句敷衍過去

lyrics.ja: 君をずっと見つめてた
lyrics.romaji: Kimi wo Zutto Mitsumeteta
lyrics.en: I was gazing at you the whole time
lyrics.zh: 我一直注視著你

lyrics.ja: Why...　ここで待ってたら　ちょっと狭くて
lyrics.romaji: Why... Koko de Mattetara Chotto Semakute
lyrics.en: Why... if I keep waiting here, it's a little too cramped
lyrics.zh: Why……若在這裡等待，空間有些狹小

lyrics.ja: Blake...　たかが知れた世界
lyrics.romaji: Blake... Takaga Shireta Sekai
lyrics.en: Blake... it's just a small, limited world
lyrics.zh: Blake……不過是微不足道的世界

lyrics.ja: 一緒に精査して分解と創造繰り返そう
lyrics.romaji: Issho ni Seisa Shite Bunkai to Souzou Kurikaesou
lyrics.en: Let's examine it together and repeat deconstruction and creation
lyrics.zh: 一起仔細探究，反覆分解與創造吧

lyrics.ja: 存在なら示すよsource
lyrics.romaji: Sonzai Nara Shimesu yo Source
lyrics.en: If it's existence, I'll show you the source
lyrics.zh: 若論存在，我會展現其源頭

lyrics.ja: 目の前のまなざしで
lyrics.romaji: Me no Mae no Manazashi de
lyrics.en: With the gaze right before my eyes
lyrics.zh: 用眼前的視線

lyrics.ja: 涙　笑顔　愛も闇も隠さず全ての想いを
lyrics.romaji: Namida Egao Ai mo Yami mo Kakusazu Subete no Omoi wo
lyrics.en: Tears, smiles, love, and darkness—without hiding, all of these feelings
lyrics.zh: 眼淚、笑容、愛與黑暗，毫不隱藏地將所有情感

lyrics.ja: 表現して誰も知らない場所まで連れてくよ
lyrics.romaji: Hyougen Shite Dare mo Shiranai Basho made Tsureteku yo
lyrics.en: Express them and I'll take you to a place no one knows
lyrics.zh: 全部表達出來，帶你到無人知曉的地方

lyrics.ja: 不確かな今を塞いだ
lyrics.romaji: Futashika na Ima wo Fusaida
lyrics.en: I sealed off this uncertain present
lyrics.zh: 堵住了這個不確定的當下

lyrics.ja: (謳歌して進化をして何度も舌を巻いて)
lyrics.romaji: (Ouka Shite Shinka wo Shite Nando mo Shita wo Maite)
lyrics.en: (Sing in praise, evolve, and be amazed again and again)
lyrics.zh: （謳歌、進化，一次又一次令人驚嘆）

lyrics.ja: お決まりの常識　振り回されずに
lyrics.romaji: Okimari no Joushiki Furimawasarezu ni
lyrics.en: Without being tossed around by conventional common sense
lyrics.zh: 不被既定的常識所擺布

lyrics.ja: まずは一歩こっちへアクセス
lyrics.romaji: Mazu ha Ippo Kocchi e Akusesu
lyrics.en: First, take one step and access this way
lyrics.zh: 首先邁出一步，朝這裡連線

lyrics.ja: 伝わったルートを辿って大事な
lyrics.romaji: Tsutawatta Ruuto wo Tadotte Daiji na
lyrics.en: Following the route that connected, I poured in
lyrics.zh: 沿著傳達而來的路徑

lyrics.ja: 感情流し込んだ
lyrics.romaji: Kanjou Nagashikonda
lyrics.en: Precious emotions
lyrics.zh: 灌注了珍貴的情感

lyrics.ja: Gray...　まだ曖昧なフェーズにいたら
lyrics.romaji: Gray... Mada Aimai na Feezu ni Itara
lyrics.en: Gray... if you're still in an ambiguous phase
lyrics.zh: Gray……若還處於曖昧的階段

lyrics.ja: Es...　君が表れて
lyrics.romaji: Es... Kimi ga Arawarete
lyrics.en: Es... you appeared
lyrics.zh: Es……你出現了

lyrics.ja: 現実と対の境界消してそっと混ざってく
lyrics.romaji: Genjitsu to Tai no Kyoukai Keshite Sotto Mazatteku
lyrics.en: Erasing the boundary opposite reality, gently blending together
lyrics.zh: 消去與現實相對的界線，靜靜交融

lyrics.ja: 平行に進んだcourse
lyrics.romaji: Heikou ni Susunda Course
lyrics.en: A course that advanced in parallel
lyrics.zh: 平行前進的路線

lyrics.ja: 手伸ばして触れない
lyrics.romaji: Te Nobashite Furenai
lyrics.en: I reach out my hand but cannot touch
lyrics.zh: 伸出手卻觸碰不到

lyrics.ja: なのに...どうしてぬくもりわかるの
lyrics.romaji: Nano ni... Doushite Nukumori Wakaru no
lyrics.en: And yet... why can I feel the warmth?
lyrics.zh: 然而……為什麼能感受到溫暖呢

lyrics.ja: 鮮明に聞こえた声
lyrics.romaji: Senmei ni Kikoeta Koe
lyrics.en: A voice I heard vividly
lyrics.zh: 清晰傳來的聲音

lyrics.ja: 逃さずにキャッチしたら
lyrics.romaji: Nogasazu ni Kyacchi Shitara
lyrics.en: If I catch it without letting it escape
lyrics.zh: 若能毫不錯過地接住

lyrics.ja: 必ず想いを重ねよう
lyrics.romaji: Kanarazu Omoi wo Kasaneyou
lyrics.en: We'll surely layer our feelings together
lyrics.zh: 必定要讓心意交疊

lyrics.ja: (リンクして共鳴して何度だって繋いで)
lyrics.romaji: (Rinku Shite Kyoumei Shite Nando Datte Tsunaide)
lyrics.en: (Link, resonate, and connect over and over)
lyrics.zh: （連結、共鳴，無論多少次都緊繫一起）
